metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: guard hooks, a development workflow (issues, PR reviews, sessions), test design, repo bootstrapping, image and video creation, artifact linters, an inventory database, and instruction files loaded like CLAUDE.md

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Hooks that block destructive Bash commands, deleting unmerged worktrees and pushing from a stale branch, and fast-forward the local base branch after a merge. Optional repo-layout rules

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Skills and hooks for the path from request to merge (including PR review routing and waiting), issue hygiene, session handoff and runbook recording, plus a mod that writes usage limits to a file

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Skills and hooks for designing and running tests: Gherkin test cases, test-artifact linting and a full-test gate

plugins.name: repo-setup
plugins.description: Skills for bootstrapping a repo: a health check of the basics, a cloud-environment setup scaffold and a builder for a project's real-app verification skill

plugins.name: creative
plugins.description: Skills for image-generation prompts and code-driven motion videos, and a lint hook for DESIGN.md

plugins.name: lint
plugins.description: Linters for artifacts. Currently skill-lint, which checks whether a skill is safe to distribute

plugins.name: inventory
plugins.description: An inventory database of the things you own: register items from photos, keep what could not be read as needs_review, and search with NFKC-normalized text. SQLite by default, or Postgres/Supabase directly or through a claude.ai connector

plugins.name: instructions
plugins.description: A mod that loads bundled instruction files the way Claude Code loads ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. Currently one file on reply language and linking files
